name: Raffles Hainan
insider_take: This ultra-luxury resort on Hainan Island represents Raffles' first foray into China, bringing legendary Singapore hospitality to tropical paradise.
whats_special: Located on pristine Shimei Bay, this all-villa resort features only 32 expansive villas, each with private pools and direct beach access. The property sits within a UNESCO World Heritage biosphere reserve, surrounded by ancient coconut groves and coral reefs. Hainan Island is known as "China's Hawaii" and offers visa-free entry for many international visitors.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments at the overwater pavilions during sunset hours - you'll have unobstructed views of the South China Sea while enjoying traditional Chinese wellness therapies.
dont_miss: The nearby Xinglong Tropical Botanical Garden showcases over 4,000 plant species, while the historic Wanquan River offers peaceful bamboo rafting through mangrove forests. For culture enthusiasts, the local Li and Miao ethnic villages provide authentic insights into Hainan's indigenous heritage.
pros: Legendary Raffles luxury service and heritage brand reputation
Premium beachfront location in tropical Sanya
Spacious suites and villas with private pools
cons: Remote island location requires planned transportation
